VENDOR SERVICES AGREEMENT

AtliQ Template: ATQ-VEN-IN v3.0

Agreement Date: _________ 2026

This Vendor Services Agreement ("Agreement") is made between:

ATLIQ TECHNOLOGIES PRIVATE LIMITED, a company incorporated under the Companies Act, 2013 (CIN U72900MH2019PTC321456; GSTIN 27AAKCA4821F1Z3), having its registered office at 4th Floor, Baner Business Bay, Pune 411045, Maharashtra, India ("AtliQ"); and

MONSOON DATA STUDIO, a partnership firm having its office at 2nd Floor, Infopark Phase 1, Kakkanad, Kochi 682042, Kerala, India ("Vendor").

## 1. SERVICES

1.1 The Vendor shall provide data engineering personnel to support AtliQ's client projects through work orders ("Work Orders").

1.2 Initial Work Order: three (3) data engineers (Azure Data Factory, dbt, Power BI) for overflow pipeline work on AtliQ's retail and logistics projects, for approximately 900 hours between October 2026 and February 2027.

## 2. TERM

2.1 This Agreement commences on 5 October 2026 and continues for twelve (12) months.

## 3. FEES AND PAYMENT

3.1 AtliQ shall pay the Vendor INR 2,000 per hour (exclusive of GST) for approved hours. Estimated value: INR 18,000,000 (approx. USD 21,500).

3.2 The Vendor shall invoice monthly. AtliQ shall pay undisputed invoices within sixty (60) days of receipt, or within ten (10) days of AtliQ receiving payment from the relevant client, whichever is later.

## 4. DELAY

4.1 Where the Vendor fails to deliver any assigned task by the agreed date, the Vendor shall pay AtliQ a penalty of one percent (1%) of the relevant Work Order value for each day of delay.

## 5. INTELLECTUAL PROPERTY

5.1 All work product, and any pre-existing materials of the Vendor incorporated into it, shall vest in AtliQ on creation.

## 6. CONFIDENTIALITY

6.1 The Vendor shall keep confidential all information of AtliQ and its clients indefinitely.

## 7. LIABILITY AND INDEMNITY

7.1 The Vendor shall indemnify AtliQ against all losses, claims, damages and expenses arising from the Services or any act or omission of the Vendor or its personnel.

7.2 AtliQ's aggregate liability shall not exceed the fees paid in the preceding one (1) month. (No limit is stated for the Vendor.)

## 8. NON-SOLICITATION AND NON-COMPETE

8.1 During the term and for twenty-four (24) months thereafter, the Vendor shall not provide any services directly to any client of AtliQ.

## 9. TERMINATION

9.1 AtliQ may terminate at any time on seven (7) days' notice. The Vendor may terminate only for AtliQ's uncured non-payment.

## 10. GENERAL

10.1 Governed by the laws of India. Courts at Pune have exclusive jurisdiction.
